snippet.title: Farwend The Road So Far
snippet.description:
From a rock in your hand to a stone hold on the hill: this is the road so far.

Since the free playtest opened on 14 November, Farwend has grown every few days: big-island worlds with cliffs, coasts and snowy peaks, a brand-new building system from timber hut to stone fortress, horses you can lasso, ride and hitch to carts, siege machines, twin blades, markets, rune vaults to crack and castles to raid.

Farwend is a Viking-age survival sandbox. Shape an island grown from a seed, forge copper, iron and steel, and stand with your clan on PvP, PvE or PvE-C servers.

▶ Play the free playtest on the Epic Games Store (until 15 March 2027): https://store.epicgames.com/p/farwend-farwend-playtest-9e8c10
▶ Release: 1 April 2027
▶ Website: https://tallyhogames.co.uk/farwend/
▶ Discord: https://discord.gg/ZYxHJvxuxk
▶ Press and creators: press@tallyhogames.co.uk
